yoooclaw-meeting-preparations 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generates concise "pre-meeting briefings" by summarizing message notifications and web search results related to the meeting theme and relevant people.
- Automatically checks for required web search capability and gracefully degrades if unavailable.
- Strictly organizes data into overview, key findings (sorted by topic), and action points per a standard template.
- Handles incomplete inputs with clear fallback responses and robust error handling.
- Optimized for last-minute information gathering and preparation before meetings.
